pages.description: Ganondorf holds Sonia's stolen Secret Stone in the ancient royal palace in this printable coloring page, raising it above his patterned robes and ornate bracelets. Curled energy lines surround the stone, while tassels, a sheathed sword, and paired Hylian banners add detailed sections to the Tears of the Kingdom coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ganondorf Guarding Princess Zelda Inside a Floating Crystal in His Castle Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ganondorf guarding Princess Zelda inside a floating crystal in his castle tower, standing with folded arms as Link approaches below. Faceted crystal panels surround Zelda's clasped hands and long gown, while Ganondorf's decorated armor, Link's shield, stone columns, and flaming braziers add detailed sections.
